column1: # Lalivero town: the wounded soldiers, Iodem's Black Orb briefing, and the ship.
# Wounded soldiers after the party reaches Lalivero.

column3: Is this more of\ntheir work?{end_now}
That voice... It's\nIodem...{end_wait}
You survived!{end_wait}
We suffered heavy\nlosses...{end_wait}
Were you fighting{pause_20_skippable} a\ngroup of six people?{end_wait}
There were...{pause_20_skippable} seven...{end_wait}
You survived as well!{end_wait}
Seven? Was it the same\ngroup you were following?{end_wait}
I'm certain. One of\nthem must have been...\n{actor_name:7}.{end_wait}
{actor_name:7}, you say...\nIs that true?{end_wait}
Kraden was protecting\nher. I'm sure it was\n{actor_name:7}...{end_wait}
Did you hear that,\n{actor_name:1}? What do they\nwant with {actor_name:7}?{end_wait}
{actor_name:7}... They all...{end_wait}
After they finished\nwith us, they headed\nfor Babi Lighthouse.{end_wait}
What could they want\nat Babi Lighthouse?{end_wait}
They spoke of the ruins{pause_20_skippable}\nbeneath the lighthouse...{end_wait}
The ruins? Then they\nmean the foundations\nof the lighthouse!{end_wait}
And Faran, master of\nLalivero, followed them\ninto the ruins...{end_wait}
I see. Faran went\nafter them, too...{end_wait}
{actor_name:1}! We must reach\nBabi Lighthouse as well.{end_wait}
Are you worried about\nthese soldiers?{end_wait}
We're alive. Do not\nworry about us. Hurry\nto the lighthouse.{end_wait}
The lighthouse...\n{actor_name:7}... If anything\nhappens... Hurry...{end_wait}
Even they are urging\nus on, {actor_name:1}. Come on!{end_wait}
We'll have to work on\nyour memory, {actor_name:1}.{end_wait}
I know we must leave,\nbut first we should hear\nIodem out.{end_wait}
We can delay our\ndeparture a little.\nLet us wait.{end_wait}
Thank you for waiting.{end_wait}
As you have guessed,\nI need to speak with you\nabout Lemuria.{end_wait}
The island of the\nancients, far out to sea.{end_wait}
When you could not find\n{actor_name:6}, you returned to\nVenus Lighthouse.{end_wait}
Yes. The base was\nflooded, and we could\nnot get out.{end_wait}
Then you looked out to\nsea, as you promised\nBabi you would.{end_wait}
Yes... We saw a region\nwrapped in mist.{end_wait}
I remembered Babi's\nwords: Lemuria is always\ncovered in mist.{end_wait}
I cannot be certain,\nbut that may have been\nLemuria...{end_wait}
If it is, then Babi's\nlife...{end_wait}
...could be saved?\nYes.{end_wait}
Then we have no choice\nbut to go...{end_now}
Good. It is settled.\nI will arrange for you\nto leave at once.{end_wait}
You gave Babi your word.\nIt means nothing if you\ndo not go at once.{end_wait}
But we still have to\nfind {actor_name:6} first...{end_wait}
That is why I asked\nyou to wait. I have\nsomething for you.{end_wait}
Iodem takes out\nthe Black Orb.{end_wait}
Is that the Black Orb?{end_wait}
You will need it to\nsail Babi's ship.{end_wait}
It will help you find\n{actor_name:6}.{end_wait}
We are grateful.{end_wait}
But I need you to find\nLemuria as soon as\npossible.{end_wait}
We gave Babi our word.\nWe will see it through.{end_wait}
{actor_name:1} got the Black\nOrb.{end_wait}
The ship is docked at\nthe edge of town.\nYou will know it.{end_wait}
Farewell. Bring back\nnews of Lemuria!{end_wait}
Right on, {actor_name:1}!\nAt last, we get to see\nthe ocean!{end_wait}
Then let's get to sea!{end_wait}
It is time to depart.{end_wait}

column1: # The ship at Idejima was not Babi's.

column3: His ship is here,\nin Lalivero.{end_wait}
So the ship at the\npeninsula belonged to\nSaturos!{end_wait}
Perhaps. But we have\nno way to learn that\nnow...{end_wait}
Yes...{pause_20_skippable} Saturos\nand Menardi are gone...{end_wait}
But now we can sail\nthe ship of the ancients!{end_wait}
It should help us\nfind {actor_name:6}.{end_wait}
